name: insulin like growth factor 2
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: IGF2 encodes insulin-like growth factor 2 [Cleaved into: Insulin-like growth factor II Ala-25 Del; Preptin]. Annotated molecular activities include hormone activity and growth factor activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Silver-Russell syndrome 3 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Loss of imprinting and increased IGF2 expression have been documented in colorectal cancer. These epigenetic/expression-associated observations are distinct from a somatic coding mutation.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
